extension.description: Local dashboard for viewing Codex quotas, credits, sessions, and accounts in VS Code.
command.openCodex: Codex Gestion: Open Codex / Sign in
config.refreshIntervalSeconds: Requested refresh interval in seconds. Plan policy may increase it; automatic direct quota queries run at most once every 30 seconds.
config.language: Language used by Codex Gestion UI.
config.language.auto: Use the VS Code display language.
config.projectContext.includeSessionExce: Include recent local Codex session excerpts in the generated project context file. Disabled by default; enabling it may write sanitized chat text to .codex-gestion/PROJECT_CONTEXT.md.
